169.sol: Chromatophores are internal membrane systems present in photosynthetic prokaryotes. These develop as membrane lined sacs or thylakoids from plasma membrane. Thylakoid membranes contain photosynthetic pigments in cyanobacteria and purple bacteria. Small sacs or granules containing pigments phycobilin are attached to these membranes. In green bacteria chromatophores are covered by non-unit, non-lipid protein membrane. They are sometimes called chlorosomes.

1949.sol: Blue baby syndrome is blood related condition found in babies due to nitrate poisoning (poisoning limits blood's ability to carry oxygen thereby causing baby to look blue); known as metheamoglobanemia. This is a serious illness in infants which is caused when nitrate is converted into nitrite in the infant's body. Nitrite interferes with the oxygen carrying capacity of the child's blood (It replaces the oxygen on the red blood cells). This is an acute disease in that symptoms can develop rapidly in infants.

80281.subject: Botany

The Avena geo-curvature test is a bioassay for auxin-type growth regulators. Triple pea test is bioassay for Ethylene. Dwarf pea test is the bioassay for GA 3 .

Assertion is incorrect, Reason is correct.

119070.text: Why do aldehydes and ketones generally have lower boiling points than alcohols of similar molecular masses?

124806.subject: Botany
124806.text: Bacteria, fungi, lower plants survive in adverse conditions by
124806.sol: Bacteria, fungi and lower plants survive in adverse conditions through formation of thick walled spores. Algae form resting spore or akinetes which are thick walled spores and store food material. In fungi, thick walled perennating spores called chlamydospores are formed. Bacteria form endospores which is probably the most resistant living thing known. They may remain alive in boiling water for more than 2 hours.

RuBisCO in C ₄ plants has higher affinity for CO ₂
six carbon acids are the primary initial CO ₂ fixation products

126261.text: Read the following statements regarding apomixis in angiosperms: (A) It is a form of asexual reproduction that mimics sexual reproduction. (B) It always results in the production of seedless fruits in families like Asteraceae and grasses. (C) It prevents the segregation of traits in the progeny of hybrid plants. (D) In some species, a diploid egg cell is formed without reduction division and develops into the embryo

126874.subject: Botany
126874.text: Which of the following is the simplest amino acid?
126874.sol: Amino acids are the monomers that make up proteins. Each amino acid has the same fundamental structure, which consists of a central carbon atom, also known as the alpha ( ) carbon, bonded to an amino group ( NH ₂ ) , a carboxyl group ( COOH ) , and to a hydrogen atom. Glycine is the simplest of all amino acids as R-group is hydrogen.

127227.subject: Botany

127227.sol: In India , ecologically unique and biodiversity-rich regions are legally protected as biosphere reserves , national parks and sanctuaries. 129438.sol: Abducens (abducent) nerve is a cranial nerve, which originated from the ventral surface of medulla oblongata. It innervates the lateral rectus muscle of eye ball.
